messages:
julia: Hey team — kickoff for the Datadog + OpenTelemetry sample-app observability bundle. Goal: provide a drop-in Redwood sample that shows tracing, request/response metrics (p50/p95), tokens/batch_size counters, and GPU utilization dashboards in Datadog. Target: joint announcement at partner sync in two weeks. Need owners for: collector config, sample-app instrumentation, Datadog dashboard JSON bundle, and the joint blog/announcements.

alex: I can own the collector config + exporter wiring. Q: do we plan OTLP/gRPC straight to Datadog, or run a local collector sidecar + Datadog agent? Datadog usually prefers agent for histogram aggregation.

ken: Based on our infra experiments, OTLP/gRPC -> local collector sidecar that forwards to Datadog agent gives best reliability and lets us keep metrics processing close to the app. For GPU metrics we should export nvidia-smi stats and NVTX spans. I'll sketch an example collector config.

sara: I'll draft the sample-app README and the blog outline. We should include perf numbers (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens) and a short how-to for Dedicated/Private deployments (KMS/PII notes). Who can run a quick benchmark?

mike: I'll coordinate with Datadog partner PM and get them to review the dashboard bundle. cc @dd_onboard_bot for the intro and dashboard acceptance checklist. They usually want a dashboard JSON + short install README.

alex: Here's a minimal OTEL collector snippet I will add to the repo (will open PR):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "${DD_API_KEY}"
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v2/otlp"
service:
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Note: we'll recommend setting DD_API_KEY via KMS for Private deployments and include instructions for agent vs direct exporter.

ken: For the sample app instrumentation (Python) I'll add an example using opentelemetry and a custom span for batch inference. Snippet: 

```python
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.requests import RequestsInstrumentor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.grpc.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor

tracer_provider = TracerProvider()
span_exporter = OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint=os.getenv("OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT"))
tracer_provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(span_exporter))
trace.set_tracer_provider(tracer_provider)
RequestsInstrumentor().instrument()

tracer = trace.get_tracer("redwood.sample")
with tracer.start_as_current_span("inference.request"):
    # attach attrs: tokens, batch_size, model_variant
    do_inference()
```

ken: I'll also wire nvidia-smi exporter so GPU memory/utilization shows up as host metrics in Datadog.

julia: Proposed owners & due dates: collector config = alex (due in 4 days), sample instrumentation = ken (due in 5 days), dashboard JSON = mike + Datadog review (due in 7 days), blog + announcement copy = sara (due in 10 days). Can everyone confirm?

alex: :thumbsup: I'll open the PR to repos/redwood/sample-observability with the collector config + short README today and add a link here.

ken: I'll run a small perf bench on Dedicated infra tomorrow and post p50/p95 + tokens/sec. Expecting numbers within our typical ranges but will capture baseline.

mike: Pinged Datadog PM (emily). She said they'll try to review the dashboard bundle by EOD Friday and will share the dashboard acceptance checklist.

dd_onboard_bot: Datadog partner contact added: @emily_dd_pm. Assigned to review dashboard bundle.

emily_dd_pm: Thanks for the ping — happy to review. Please include: dashboard JSON, sample metrics list, and install steps. We'll check for metric naming conventions and recommend out-of-the-box widgets (timeseries + top lists + heatmap for GPU).

julia: Great. I'll add this to the partnership tracker and schedule a 30m sync — Wednesday 9:00am PT. Agenda: quick status, collector PR review, dashboard review, blog timeline. Drive draft: https://drive.google.com/sample-observability-draft (internal).

sara: If anyone needs help with blog content or customer quotes, DM me. Also we should capture KMS and PII notes for Private deployments — add a short section in the README.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sample-observability/pull/42 — contains collector config + initial README.

ken: Perf run results (quick): p50=28ms, p95=120ms, tokens/sec=450 on a single 80GB A100 pod (batch_size=8). Uploading the exact run logs to the drive.

mike: Datadog review scheduled. Will post dashboard JSON when emily approves.

julia: Thanks everyone — this is progressing. Will share calendar invite and tracker link.

alex: will follow up with the PR updates and add a short how-to for Dedicated vs Hosted routing.
